title: moonhornResourcePack
description: This is the companion resource pack for the datapack：moonhorn. You can modify files within it to customize the horn sounds, and you can also use several built-in horns normally through the datapack.You need to download the corresponding version of the Moon
body:
Thank you for downloading and using this resource pack.

Supported versions: 1.21.1-1.21.10
Author: 扫地机器人Moon(Moon_lightC)

You can find me on Bilibili and follow me to support me,thank you!!!

This resource pack is designed to be used with the accompanying data pack MoonHornDataPack (moonhorn), adding a variety of new horn sounds to enhance the fun in multiplayer games for you and your friends.

It adds over 10 synthesized horn sound effects, two of which are QQ and WeChat notification sounds stored in the path assetsmoonhornsoundsorigin. The files custom0-11 in assetsmoonhornsoundscustom are audio files that users can modify and replace with the same name. Of course, their extensions must be .ogg. These sound effects are called by the data pack and are intended to prank your friends. You need to make sure that all players you want to prank have installed your modified resource pack.

Can't find the sound effects you want to use or only want to use QQ and WeChat notification sounds? Don’t worry. If custom sound effects are not replaced, they will play selected original Minecraft cave and Nether sounds...
